content.comment_body: Hello, I purchased a [company_name] [product_name] with display intending to use it as the controller for my thermal solar panel setup. I've programmed it successfully, and everything is functioning well. Now I'm focusing on refining and improving the software. I'm aiming to add a feature on the controller that users can enable or disable from the local display (with ON or OFF states). What is the best way to handle this? Where should I store the digital value so it can be modified directly via the display? I was able to manage analog values (like adjusting the system's temperature setpoint) by saving the value within a calculation block and editing it in the message text block. However, I'm not sure how to replicate this for digital values. Thank you for the assistance.

You can use a softkey, which serves as a switch or button. You access the softkey through a message text. Here's how to use a softkey: If you have several message texts, use the softkey to select the message text you want. When viewing the message text, hold down ESC for over two seconds. If there are no input fields or other softkeys in the message text, a black bar appears on the softkey; if there are, use the cursor keys to select the desired softkey. Once you select it, press OK—the bar will flash. Now, change the softkey state using the up/down cursor keys and confirm with OK. Press ESC to exit edit mode.
Hi [user_name], I'm also working with software switches and have a suggestion for how to show the status on the display. Best regards, [user_name]

Hello [user_name], [user_name], Thank you so much for your quick responses; that's exactly what I needed. I completely overlooked that information in the online help. While the documentation is generally helpful, sometimes advice from the forum is even more valuable! Really appreciate everyone's help. Best regards

analysis.insight_summary: Users configuring the [product_name] with display are seeking to enable or disable digital functions directly from the device interface. Although managing analog values through text message editing was straightforward, the process for binary ON/OFF states was unclear until community suggestions referenced using softkeys and software switches. This discussion highlights a need for clear, accessible methods to let users toggle digital features via the onboard screen.
analysis.user_expectations: Users desire a simple and intuitive way to set and change ON/OFF options for controller features from the onboard display, ideally replicating the ease of analog value adjustments.
